title: Assembly of Itinerants
content: The Russian realist artists known as thePeredvizhniki(Wanderers or Itinerants) assembled for this 1875 photo.1st row from left:Konstantin Makovsky, Alexander Beggrov, Ammosov, Ivatchov, Ivan Shishkin,Nikolay Nevrev, Volkov, Kirill Lemokh, Kiselyov, Nikolay Yaroshenko, Illarion Pryanishnikov , Ilya Repin.2nd row from left:Vladimir Makovsky, Alexander Litovtchenko, Konstantin Savitsky, Ivan Kramskoi,Masondrov, Bryullov, Vasily Surikov, Vasily Polenov. Photo by Michail Panov.ThePeredvizhnikirebelled against the artificial assignments of the Imperial Academy and applied their skills of realism to portray landscape scenes and naturalistic portrayals of common people.Konstantin Savitsky, Repairing the Railroad, 1874They were Itinerants in the sense that their paintings were shown in traveling exhibitions around Russia where they were admired by a wider viewership.
